svg.title: Routing and simulator
svg.desc: Pulsus Dash notification routing: policy tree with match counts, a Sankey of the last 7 days of notifications from label sets through routes to endpoints (PagerDuty, Slack, email, ServiceNow webhook), a simulator where pasted labels highlight the matching path with per-matcher explanations, and per-endpoint delivery health including a degraded ServiceNow webhook retrying with a meta-alert to the fallback route.

g.text: Policy tree v14 · edited 11-12 by @priya · Git-synced ✓
last 7 days · label sets → routes → endpoints · width ∝ notifications
every attempt recorded: response, latency, retries · last 7 d
♥ heartbeat → Better Stack every 60 s · last 12 s ago ●
